methods.name: Exact tetrahedral slice-transport and Spin-holonomy checker
capabilities: all ordered triangular face holonomy products
integral quaternion edge-spinor and face-spinor products
Spin sign reversal under face orientation reversal
methods.exactness: Fraction matrices and integer quaternions; no floating point, trigonometry, or numerical pi in the finite core
boundaries: does not derive the shortest SO3 handoff from P000 native dynamics
does not identify the carrier sphere with primitive native angle or area
does not identify the Spin sign with other project C2 classes
